Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on site-specific N- and O-glycosylation of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein. Acquisition is DDA (top 15 precursors, dynamic exclusion). Quantification is label-free based on AUC. Enrichment was performed using HILIC resin. PNGase F was used for site occupancy analysis, introducing a deamidation mass shift (0.984 Da) at N-glycosites.
